title: Macron visits Malaysia as France seeks closer defence and rare earths ties
summary: French President Emmanuel Macron will meet Malaysian Prime Minister Anwar Ibrahim in Kuala Lumpur on Tuesday to discuss strengthening defence, trade, energy and critical minerals co-operation. Macron's two-day visit, his first since 2017, comes ahead of the countries' 70th anniversary of diplomatic relations, with both sides seeking a strategic partnership.
